name: read_extract_notebook_output_text
notes: Notebook single-output renderer: drives the REAL src/tools/read_extract.c::read_extract_notebook_output_text (linked via extra_src with libjson + libansi + libwubuoffice) against LIVE tools/read_extract.py::_notebook_output_text. Coarse ladder (empty / stream / error / result-shapes) + canonical result V event. Covers stream lists, ANSI/CR collapse via both strip_ansi implementations, traceback joins, widget omission, v3 flat mime fallback, image size placeholders, html char-count placeholder, unknown-mime fallback, markdown preference, non-dict and malformed JSON. Inputs kept below the 1000-char comma-grouping threshold of the html placeholder where the C %zu formatting diverges from Python's '{:,}'. PORT FIX: src/tools/read_extract.c v3-flat branch previously json_set() the BORROWED out['png'/'jpeg'/'svg'/'html'] node into data_owned, causing a double-free when data_owned was freed before out; now deep-copied via serialize+parse.
